# opnsense_diagnostics_netflow (Resource)

Manages Netflow diagnostics configuration. This is a singleton resource that manages existing upstream configuration.

**Important:** This resource must be imported before it can be managed:
```bash
terraform import opnsense_diagnostics_netflow.netflow netflow_settings
```

After importing, you can manage the configuration with `terraform apply`. Running `terraform destroy` will remove the resource from state but will NOT modify the upstream configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// opnsense_diagnostics_netflow is a SINGLETON resource.
//
// There should only ever be ONE instance of this resource in your Terraform
// configuration. It manages the global Netflow diagnostics configuration for
// your OPNsense appliance.
//
// IMPORTANT: This resource cannot be created via `terraform apply`. You must
// import it first, then manage it going forward.
//
// Import using the fixed ID "netflow_settings":
//
//   terraform import opnsense_diagnostics_netflow.netflow netflow_settings
//
// After importing, running `terraform destroy` will only remove the resource
// from Terraform state — it will NOT reset or delete the upstream configuration.

// Import block (Terraform v1.5+)
import {
  to = opnsense_diagnostics_netflow.netflow
  id = "netflow_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_diagnostics_netflow" "netflow" {
  enabled                = true
  interfaces             = ["wan"]
  egress_only_interfaces = []
  version                = "v9"
  targets                = ["10.0.0.10:2055"]
  active_timeout         = 1800
  inactive_timeout       = 15
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active_timeout` (Number) Active flow timeout, in seconds. Defaults to `1800`.
- `egress_only_interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces to capture egress-only Netflow data on. Defaults to `[]`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable Netflow data collection. Defaults to `false`.
- `inactive_timeout` (Number) Inactive flow timeout, in seconds. Defaults to `15`.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces to capture Netflow data on. Defaults to `[]`.
- `targets` (Set of String) Netflow collector targets, as `host:port` pairs. Defaults to `[]`.
- `version` (String) Netflow protocol version to export. Defaults to `"v9"`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always set to `netflow_settings`. Use this value when importing: `terraform import opnsense_diagnostics_netflow.netflow netflow_settings`
